welcomeBody: Get ready for today's battle. Open your dashboard, protect your well-being, and stay in the safe zone.
passwordMin: Password must be at least 6 characters
forgotSent: If the email is registered, you will receive instructions to reset your password.
completeProfileSubtitle: Set up your stats and invite your guardians
completeProfileLater: You can change this information later from your profile.
guestStartSubtitle: Create an account or use SugarCheck without logging in. Records and history work offline; videos, chat, and linking an account require internet.
guestAccountTitle: You are using a local profile
guestAccountDescription: Create an account or log in whenever you like to link your data and access it on other devices.
guestPrivacy: In guest mode, your data stays on this device and is not synced unless you choose to link it to an account.
guestOnboardingIntro: Hi! Tell me a little about yourself so I can set up your space. All of these details are required to continue.
guestDataNotice: Your information will be stored on this device and can be reviewed in your profile. Videos, chat, and linking an account require internet.
guestContactHint: This can be a family member or anyone you trust.
personalGoalPrompt: What would you like to achieve with SugarCheck?
guestGlucoseRangeHint: Enter the range recommended by you or your care team. The app does not recommend values.
guestInvalidWeight: Enter a valid weight in kilograms.
guestInvalidHeight: Enter a valid height in centimeters.
guestInvalidName: Enter a name between 3 and 50 characters.
guestInvalidContactName: Enter a contact name between 3 and 50 characters.
guestInvalidBirthDate: Select a valid birth date that is not in the future.
guestInvalidPhone: Enter a valid phone number for your contact.
guestInvalidRange: Enter a valid range: both values must be positive and the maximum must exceed the minimum.
guestSaveError: Your profile could not be saved on this device. Please try again.
guestImportSubtitle: Hi, {{name}}. You can import the data on this device to your account now or do it later.
guestImportIncluded: The following will be linked to your account:
guestImportProfile: Your profile, goal, contact, glucose range, and character.
guestImportNotice: Your local data will remain if linking fails. After a successful import, it will be removed from this device.
guestImportError: We could not link all data. It has been kept on this device; check your connection and try again.
guestDialogue0: Hi! I'm Gluco, your companion on this adventure. First, what's your name?
guestDialogue1: Nice to meet you! About how much do you weigh?
guestDialogue3: Now tell me, what sex should I record on your profile?
guestDialogue5: Who can we contact if you need help? It can be someone you trust.
guestDialogue6: What's your relationship to this person?
guestDialogue8: What would you like to achieve with SugarCheck?
guestDialogue9: Last question: what glucose target range did your care team recommend?
guestDialogue10: Almost there! Choose the character who will join you.
